name: Arena-Hard
intro: Arena-Hard 通过BenchBuilder从Chatbot Arena众包查询中去重并过滤非英文和多轮内容，进行嵌入、UMAP与HDBSCAN主题聚类，再按特异性、复杂度等7项质量维度筛选并从250个簇各取2题形成500条困难提示，最后以成对LLM裁判和Bradley-Terry模型汇总胜率。
build_method: 众包查询清洗, 主题聚类, 七维质量评分, 困难提示采样
task_type: 开放式对话, 指令跟随
eval_feature: 真实用户困难提示, BenchBuilder, 成对LLM裁判, 风格控制
build_method_en: Crowdsourced-query cleaning, topic clustering, seven-axis quality scoring, hard-prompt sampling
eval_feature_en: Real-user hard prompts, BenchBuilder, pairwise LLM judging, style control
intro_en: Arena-Hard uses BenchBuilder to deduplicate Chatbot Arena queries, remove non-English and multi-turn content, cluster prompts with embeddings, UMAP, and HDBSCAN, score seven quality dimensions, and sample two prompts from each of 250 clusters to form 500 hard prompts. Pairwise LLM judgments are aggregated with a Bradley-Terry model.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2406.11939 and the official Arena-Hard-Auto repository. BenchBuilder starts from Chatbot Arena crowdsourced queries, removes duplicates, non-English prompts, and multi-turn conversations, clusters embedded prompts with UMAP and HDBSCAN, scores seven prompt-quality attributes, and samples two prompts from each of 250 clusters for 500 items. Model responses are pairwise judged with position swapping and aggregated through Bradley-Terry win rates with optional style controls.
